Res.Caption: Request Re-Route of ACH Payment Auth.
Res.ShortCaption: Request Re-Route of ACH Payment Auth.
Res.FullDescription: Tick to request re-route of ACH Payment Authorization

Res.Caption: Request For All Ports
Res.FullDescription: Tick this field to receive all statements for all ports in the receiver district port. If not ticked, the system will reroute only those statements that match the processing district, port filer, and office code of the current branch.

Res.Caption: Client Branch
Res.FullDescription: Client Branch is user for Preliminary or Final Statement request only. Use this field if requesting a statement for a particular branch of the office. If not requesting a statement for a particular branch, leave blank.

Res.Caption: Request Re-Route Final Statement
Res.FullDescription: Tick to request re-route of Final Statement(s).

Res.Caption: Importer of Record Number
Res.FullDescription: Importer of Record Number is use for Preliminary or Final Statement request only. Use this field if requesting a statement for a particular importer, otherwise, leave blank.

Res.Caption: Message Type
Res.FullDescription: The message type to request a reroute from Customs. Option are ACS = 'ACS ABI (Legacy)' and ACE = 'ACE ABI'.

Res.Caption: Request Re-Route Periodic Statement Payment Authorization
Res.ShortCaption: Request Re-Route Periodic Stat. Pay. Auth.
Res.FullDescription: Tick to request re-route of Periodic Statement payment authorization.

Res.Caption: Request Re-Route Preliminary Statement
Res.FullDescription: Tick to request re-route of Preliminary Statement(s).

Res.Caption: Processing Port
Res.FullDescription: The system will reroute only those statements that match the processing district, port filer, and office code of the current branch.

Res.Caption: Statement Type
Res.FullDescription: The statement type to request a reroute from Customs. Option are D = 'Daily' and P = 'Periodic Monthly'.

Res.Caption: Statement Number
Res.FullDescription: Fill this field if the statement number is known. The system will retrieve the statement indicated in this field. If the statement is not known, leave blank. The last 3 positions may be alpha characters due to the increase in the numbers of statements being generated in some of the larger ports.

Res.Caption: Transmission Date
Res.FullDescription: The Transmission Date of the Statement or ACH Payment Transaction. The date may not be more than 14 days in the past.
